nom: Lancôme Advanced Génifique Anti-Aging Face Serum - Hydrates & Plumps Skin

avis.titre: I cried but my wallet and I can’t complain
avis.texte: When I saw what this costs I died a little inside. My wallet shrieked and my heart skipped a beat - pure panic. Isn’t this just overpriced fancy lotion? Then, a very direct rhetorical question was boldly posed to me, and, of course I replied with “no I don’t want you to look old.” Then almost immediately I followed that response with “yes it really does work.” Do not fly too close to the sun.

My wife really loves this product. We used to purchase it at the department store but having found it on Amazon, we get the same quality as the one we bought from the store. It offers moisture and a nice glow when applied.
Perfect in every way , skin is very renewed, clearer, fewer wrinkles, etc
One of the best products to maintain healthy, youthful appearance
One of the few serums that work!! Buy the big bottle. Best deal!
This product is one that I have used for many years. It is part of my daily skincare regimen; I have it as one of my " Subscribe and Saves."
This stuff is amazing - watch qvc and ulta since it goes on sale a little but if not amazon has deals also.
2本目になります。 肌の凹凸や毛穴の開きが改善されている気がします。 私にとっては高価な品物ですが外すことの出来ないマストアイテムになっています。
Diese Menge ist sehr kostengünstig und hält sehr lange! God sei Dank! Das Produkt ist einfach genial gegen Falten und riech wunderbar.
